scripts/verify/check_github_environment_.justification: Lists GitHub Environment secret/variable names via `gh secret list` / `gh variable list`, which needs a repo-admin-scoped token. The workflows' default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read that listing (no such permission exists in the Actions permissions block), and this repo provisions no admin PAT for CI -- adding one to wire this in would itself be the sensitive, separately-reviewed change GOU-178 is not scoped to make. Run manually by an operator with `gh auth login` before rotating ops/config/deployment-inputs.yml or ops/config/runtime-input-contract.yml, the same class of exemption as check_promotion_readiness.py below.

scripts/verify/check_promotion_readiness.justification: Reconciles the live Paperclip project (phase labels, owner decision, beta mandate) before a promotion; its own docstring states it is local, read-only and requires the live Paperclip API, which CI does not have. publish-java-release.sh and publish-nuxt-release.sh instead require and verify an Ed25519-signed gate proof (scripts/deploy/verify_gate_proof.py) that this script alone produces -- see docs/operations/promotion-readiness-gate.md. Running it is therefore an operator action before publish, not a CI or publish-script invocation.
